name: OppPilot
author: opppilot

sections.description:
OppPilot pushes a short weekly task list to this site. The plugin shows it on the dashboard and links back to OppPilot. It does not phone home, and it does not store an OppPilot password.

External services

This plugin does not contact any external service by itself.

After you choose to connect, the OppPilot service (https://opppilot.com) pushes a weekly summary to this site using the application password you approved. The summary contains: a schema version, the time it was generated, a total item count, up to five items (keyword, action, priority), and one URL back to the OppPilot app.

  • Terms of service: https://opppilot.com
  • Privacy policy: https://opppilot.com/privacy

The terms URL is the product homepage until a dedicated terms page is confirmed.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin and activate it.
  2. Open Tools → OppPilot and choose “Connect OppPilot”.
  3. In OppPilot, connect this site and send a summary.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin send data to OppPilot?

No. OppPilot sends the summary to this site. The plugin only stores that summary locally.

How do I disconnect?

Use “Disconnect” on the settings page to delete the stored summary. Also revoke the OppPilot application password under Users → Profile → Application Passwords. The plugin does not revoke it for you.
